cases.reason: Explicit overwrite through alias redirects success to second, with OPEN question.
Caller pointer rebinding leaves captured wrapper and result on original breaker.

findings.reason: Unqualified returned outcome accounting omits generation guard: a concurrent transition can discard an admitted outcome; gobreaker.go:293-301.
The before-expiry report need not apply if another operation changed the generation before it; condition does not exclude that ordering (afterRequest:293-301). Other expiry behaviors are supported.
Allow closure, generation check and onSuccess half-open threshold support duplicate, distinct and abandoned cases.
Captured wrapper dereferences cb on invocation; archived rebinding and reassignment probes pass; sync/mutex.go:20 prohibits copying Mutex after first use.
Execute defer, recover and afterRequest generation gate support qualified panic/Goexit behavior; legacy panicnil case correctly scoped.
afterRequest locks and samples time, onFailure records counts and invokes hooks; setState resets and calls hook under mutex.
